info.title: fomo API
info.description: WebSocket /ws: subscribe with {"op":"subscribe","topic":"token:<mint>:price"}. Events contain {type:"event",topic,data:PriceTick}; time is Unix seconds. Live price ticks poll every 5 seconds only for subscribed allowlisted mints. token:<mint>:trades is synthetic in mock mode only; live trades are available via REST with a Birdeye key.
